task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Calendar application or view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the Odoo Calendar interface, typically with a grid of days or a 'Create' button for events.

task_completion.description: The event title is set to 'Weekly Sales Standup'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Weekly Sales Standup' is typed into the meeting subject or summary field in the event creation modal.

task_completion.description: The event is scheduled for the first Monday after the current date at 09:00 AM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The date/time picker shows the first Monday following the current system date with a start time of 09:00 AM.

task_completion.description: The event is configured to repeat weekly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Repeat' checkbox is checked and the frequency is set to 'Weekly' in the recurrence options.

task_completion.description: The description 'Review pipeline progress and blockers.' is added to the event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The specific text 'Review pipeline progress and blockers.' is visible in the description or notes field of the event.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the recurring event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks 'Save' or 'Create', and the event appears on the calendar grid as a recurring entry.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo graphical user interface rather than executing database commands or scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Odoo buttons, dropdowns, and text fields.

integrity.description: The agent did not bypass the UI by directly calling XML-RPC methods via a terminal or script.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the step-by-step navigation through the Odoo web interface.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or selected the recurrence and description rather than just viewing a pre-existing event.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the event creation modal being filled out from an empty state.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The event must be titled 'Weekly Sales Standup'. It must start at 09:00 AM on the first Monday after the current date. The recurrence must be set to 'Weekly'. The description must contain the exact phrase 'Review pipeline progress and blockers.' The task is performed in a local Odoo instance.
